Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to paint and make pretty pictures of toys. One day, Tim had a big dream. It was a very pretty picture, and it was very heavy. Tim wanted to learn more pictures to make things. Tim had a big box. He said, "I will put a picture on it!" His friend, Sam, came over to play.
